checks.protects: Markdown and template files must not reference a specific line number, since the reference silently drifts out of sync the moment either file is edited.
Repository text and commit messages in the PR range must not contain filesystem paths, email addresses, or maintainer-private strings, since a public repository cannot redact history after the fact.

Each ADR file must follow the docs/adr/NNNN-slug.md naming scheme, declare one of the four valid Status values, and reference other ADRs by ID only, since a broken or ambiguous decision record cannot be trusted the next time it is read.
